text:
DFI Retail, the food and beverage unit of Hong Kong-headquartered conglomerate Jardine Matheson, is looking to sell its mall at The Peak, one of the city’s wealthiest neighbourhoods.
The entire commercial portion of the Dairy Farm Guildford Road Shopping Centre will be sold via a public tender closing at noon on November 19, according to sole agent CBRE.

text_zh:
DFI零售，香港总部怡和集团旗下的食品和饮料部门，正寻求出售其位于山顶的商场，山顶是香港最富裕的社区之一。
牛奶公司吉福德路购物中心的整个商业部分将通过公开招标出售，截止时间为11月19日中午，独家代理为CBRE。
